quest.title: Incidents Are Ever Sudden
quest.description: At Pakpaka Flying School, what seemed like just another routine challenge mission at first...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: #Welcome... Hmm, it looks like one of you has already mastered the skill of flying. So, is this the {M#young man}{F#young lady} who wants to learn how to fly?

choices.text: I already have a gliding license.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Gliding license? First time I've heard of that.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Here, we aim to have Saurian and rider stride toward improvement together. Your partner...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrah, rawr!

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: ...Hmm, sorry, little guy, but I doubt Pakpaka Flying School is the place for you to show off your skills. Not your fault, though, so don't take it personally.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is still young, and still has lots of potential to unlock.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no way a Tepetlisaurus's potential for flight can match that of a Qucusaurus or Iktomisaurus!

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: #Either way, {M#young man}{F#young lady}, if you're interested in our flying training, I recommend that you try our training course!

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: You'll need to be able to dodge obstacles and turn with agility to ride a Qucusaurus. You'll know just how good you are after trying the training course!

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: To be honest, we've worked really hard to promote it. We've got the prizes prepared, races organized, the works. If you pass, go to Lamizana to claim your prize.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll give it a try.

talks.objective: Find Lamizana to claim your reward

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: As your senior, your older brother, even, let me teach you how to fit in and become popular.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Thanks, but that's not necessary. And you're not my older brother, either...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: By the way, can you stop giving Oberon crackers?

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Coooo.... Guguuuu...

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Hey, listen here, you little brat, if it wasn't for your sister...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, I'm here to claim a prize.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Oh, a rare guest. We don't see small Tepetlisaurs every day here. And combined with this... Well, you sure have quite a few different breeds of companions, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Breeds...!? Paimon and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} aren't even remotely the same thing!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Hroowr? Wrooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? No, well, we're both {NICKNAME}'s companions, sure, but we're not entirely the same. Paimon isn't saying that either of us is better or worse, so don't be sad.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The truth hurts the most when it just slips out...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, you know that's not what Paimon's saying, so don't try to make things more complicated. {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is a great buddy of ours!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #You're also a great companion, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Hroo? Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, Paimon knew you'd get it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Wow, that's actually some pretty impressive rapport. Your clothes scream that you're not locals, yet the trust and friendship between you and this Tepetlisaurus runs deep. What's your secret?

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: I mean, I won't sugarcoat it. Taruka and his Qucusaurus are partners, but they don't get along very well. If you really do know a secret, I'd love for him to learn it.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Instead of picking on me, why don't we talk about... Where their prizes are? Don't tell me they aren't ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Of course they're ready! Just as ready as you are to change the subject, in fact. Which is something I'll have to talk to you about later...

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: We'll be holding an air race soon. If you're interested, don't miss out on this chance to watch it and my wonderful performance! I've got stuff to do and places to be now, though, so I'll be on my way.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: How many Saurus Crackers did that Lamizana feed you...

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Croooo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was so easy to get these rewards... Paimon wishes that the Adventurers' Guild's commissions were all as easy as this!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, are you adventurers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have an Adventurer Handbook, but Paimon doesn't.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmph! Paimon can be an adventurer at heart without something like that, just like how she's just as skilled as {NICKNAME} at flying, license or no!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you asking because you have a commission for us? Wait, don't tell Paimon yet — let her guess first. There's only one answer—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You must have seen how close {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is to us, and you wanna ask us about our secret to getting along so well! Is Paimon right or is she right?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Uh, not even close.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But Lamizana said...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: He's the one with a problem. He's really good at winning people over. Even Oberon listens to him now that he fed him a bunch of Saurus Crackers.

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Crooo, Cooooo...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Stop acting like you're the one who's been wronged. A top-notch Qucusaurus must follow a strict diet. What's more, you're the type who packs on the pounds easily.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: That guy must have an ulterior motive for fawning over my sister Lliwa time and again... I don't understand why she isn't wary of him at all. They even talk and laugh together!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Sounds like he's a nice guy. Are you biased because you don't like him?

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: No, there's more to it than that. He's been really secretive recently, and I don't know what he's been doing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adults always have things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, didn't he mention an air race? Maybe he's been busy organizing that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He mentioned an air race that was being organized...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: But he hasn't put all that much effort into this. All the prep and hard work's been done by Paran. The way he's running all over with Carrewoof this whole time, it's easy to tell who is doing the heavy lifting.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: I overheard something yesterday too! He was discussing dangerous stuff with some outsider on the sly. I didn't dare to get too close, so I didn't hear everything, but...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: I heard "Be on time on the day of the race," "Don't go too far," "lives," "I'll pay the other half after you succeed," and "We'll discuss the details at the north camp tomorrow night"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why is it that you only heard the second half so clearly?

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to Oberon. He was particularly restless at that time and trying to go off to see Lamizana. In the end, I just couldn't stop him...

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Croooo!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: That's not praise, you ninny. Anyway, the other person left quickly after seeing me chasing Oberon. Lamizana also acted pretty unnaturally after that.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: He must have tried to pick a fight with me today because he was worried that he might be exposed. He just wants to give himself a good excuse to keep a close eye on me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa. For a kid, you sure think about complicated things.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: I get it. You don't trust the words of a child either, right?

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: #But that's exactly why I want to ask {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} to investigate the north camp with me at night... Y'know, just in case he really is plotting something dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: #In which case, we've gotta put a stop to it! With {M#him}{F#her} here as my witness, the others will definitely believe me... and Lliwa too!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, if you think all this is just a kid's overactive imagination, and don't want to go yourself, then at least help me deliver a message.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: I've written a short letter explaining the situation. If I don't come back by tomorrow, please deliver it to Lliwa. I'll also entrust Oberon to her care...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a minute! You're sounding more and more ominous. Things can't possibly be that serious, right... Hmm, wait, what if they are...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, why don't we investigate? Paimon's gonna have nightmares if something really does happen after we ignore this!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: You're willing to help me? Hooray! In that case, let's go together tonight...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just leave it to us. You should stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! More people aren't necessarily better in an investigation. You should stay here and wait for news from us. Paimon's an experienced adventurer too, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Well... you do have a point. I'll stay here and take care of Oberon, then. I also need to persuade Lliwa to keep her distance from Lamizana...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: So I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: Just need to pass through that circle... Through that circle...

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: The training course should be simple enough now, right? Wh—What, you're saying it needs to be even simpler? You mean it's best if everyone can participate and pass?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: We'll be back later.

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: Congratulations on completing the challenge! You can claim your prize from Lamizana. He's nearby in some conspicuous place.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Don't touch it — this is a prize. If you're interested in our prizes, please complete the training course that Temach's prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Heh, you should really do something about your bad temper. I'm saying that for your good, alright? You're old enough to learn to be more sensible, for your own sake, even if it isn't for your sister's.

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Cooo, Croooo.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: See? It agrees with me.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Even if one of us had to lack sense, that person wouldn't be me.

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: Hey! You brat...

dialogues.speaker: Paran
dialogues.text: Sorry, Ms. Quilla. Carrewoof didn't hurt you, did he? He isn't usually nearly that enthusiastic towards strangers.

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm fine. I love interacting with animals. If anything, the affection makes me happy.

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: By the way, Hawka misses you a lot. When he heard that I would be coming here soon, he had me ask about how you've been doing.

dialogues.speaker: Paran
dialogues.text: ...Uncle Hawka? Why would he care about me? Ugh, I'm sorry, we've had some clashes, but they aren't worth mentioning...

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: How troublesome...

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Well, I have a little brother who's a lot younger than me. Maybe he's just in his rebellious years, but he doesn't get along with anyone...

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Bah, I'll only add to your troubles by telling you about this. Things will probably get better when he grows up!

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: It's no trouble. See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Carrewoof
dialogues.text: *whimper*...

dialogues.speaker: Cisik
dialogues.text: Want to try out the training course?

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: We still have a few more flying challenges. Details are written on the board. Give 'em a try if you're keen... Of course, there are prizes to be won.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Honestly, I have no clue why it's called that. But speaking of Pakpaka... Have you ever heard the story of Kuntur and the evil sorcerer Rumi?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: The warriors of the tribe were defeated by that wicked mage, and he turned them into Pakpaka... which doesn't sound all that good. Maybe Pakpakas fly very quickly, or something — I don't know.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Haha... He's a good fighter, but not necessarily a good teacher. And as an opponent in flying competitions... I guess he's passable?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: But I mean, why would you come here if you didn't have issues with flying? So, if I were to be too strict... *sigh* Well, it's not like things like this have never happened in the past.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: That's why I focus on encouraging people nowadays. I'm sure that approach will get results just fine too.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: See you. You're welcome back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Cisik
dialogues.text: Welcome to Pakpaka Flying School!

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: We give all cadets the necessary guidance and help they need. Things have changed a lot, you know. Back in the day, students couldn't expect that kind of tender loving care.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: But then there was this one time when the coach was a little... strict with their words, and the student in question just happened to have quite a temper... *sigh* Yeah, that's not a fun one to talk about.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Anyway, our teaching policy's been shaken up since then. And I mean, nobody slaps a smiling face, and nobody hates compliments, am I right?

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Here's to a pleasant day!
